claims: As of March 20, 2026, the 30-year fixed rate is roughly 6.53%.
As of March 20, 2026, 30-year fixed rates range from 6.00% to over 6.5% depending on the lender.
Mortgage News Daily reported an average top-tier 30-year fixed rate of 6.53% as of March 20, 2026.
As of March 20, 2026, 15-year fixed rates are typically higher than 5.50%.
As of March 20, 2026, some lenders quote 15-year fixed rates around 5.62% to 5.75%.
As of March 20, 2026, FHA 30-year fixed rates are generally in the upper 5% to low 6% range.
As of March 20, 2026, mortgage rates mark some of the highest figures since September 2025.
Mortgage News Daily noted rates hit their highest level in six months following a treasury selloff.
The rise in rates has led to a decrease in mortgage applications.
Many advertised low rates such as those at Bank of America often require paying points to reduce the rate.
